entities.name: Anna Sjödin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Sjödin is a Swedish Social Democratic politician, and elected president of the Social Democratic Youth League from 3 August 2005 to 16 December 2006. She was also elected vice president of the International Union of Socialist Youth (IUSY) at the congress in January 2006. Sjödin is the second woman, after Anna Lindh, to be elected president of the Social Democratic Youth League.
